Record Class FundamentalAnswer

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
grafioschtrader.connector.fundamental.FundamentalAnswer
Record Components:
rows - the values read from a usable answer, empty for a failed one
evidence - what the source checks read from the same answer without storing it, such as Eulerpool's net income
reason - why the answer is not usable, null for a usable one
httpStatus - status of a failed request, 0 when no answer arrived or the answer was usable
public record FundamentalAnswer(List<SecurityFundamental> rows, Map<String,Double> evidence, String reason, int httpStatus) extends Record
Outcome of one request for fundamental data. A usable answer is HTTP 200 with a parseable body containing the expected root object; its rows replace every stored row of that source for the security, so that a metric the source no longer delivers disappears. A failed answer leaves the stored rows of the source untouched.
